marginNotes: The primary products (Petrol and Diesel) are historically excluded from GST and are subject to Value Added Tax (VAT) and Central Excise. GST is applicable only to lubricants (Servo), CNG (in some contexts of transmission/service), and dealer commissions.
Retailing Servo lubricants adds a high-margin revenue stream.

The station’s product mix is its strongest competitive differentiator, moving beyond the commodity trap of standard petrol/diesel to offer high-margin, brand-building products like XP100, XP95, and XtraGreen Diesel.
The combination of a PUC center, Servicing/Washing (implied by Orange category), and CNG makes it a "One-Stop Shop".
The existence of consumer litigation records highlights a history of friction that requires careful customer relationship management.
